verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a first-party API surface: an API reference with Custom Integration Push APIs (integration monitoring) and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs. These cover only narrow data-push and read slices, while nearly all documented workflows are UI 'dashboard actions'. These include access reviews, vendor risk assessments, questionnaires, audit partner selection, AI systems governance, and task assignment. No OpenAPI spec was found at any candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for core UI workflows (controls, policies, risks, tasks, access reviews, audits, AI systems), write/manage endpoints beyond integration push, a published OpenAPI spec, and any statement or hands-on evidence of UI–API parity.
